acceptanceCriteria: The cause of the per-subtest cost is identified with a profile or timing evidence.
The package's hosted race time is reduced or the tests are split so no single package exceeds the balanced shard target, without weakening the bounds or forgery assertions.
Before and after hosted timings are retained.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Confirmed slow symptom, cause not diagnosed: internal/testacceptance took 953.5s, the largest package and 17% of all test time. TestPTFV0ParentCompleteAttemptOutcomeBounds 379.8s (attempts-16 subtests 178s each), ...NativeForgery 283.4s (about 24s per subtest), ...Correspondence 153.5s, ...AttemptOutcome 115.4s. Last change 69eddced (2026-10-03). Package-level sharding cannot split one package, so this is the lower bound on any shard regardless of shard count.
title: testacceptance: PTF parent-complete attempt-outcome tests take 953s under race and set the CI floor
